text:
sophie: Quick sync request 1: tighten the welcome + launch drip for the benchmark webinar (next Tue). Mobile-first, concise, and two segment priorities. Who can pick this up?

maria: I can drive. Goals: maximize register rate, keep welcome <120 words, and minimize image weight for small cohorts.

josh: Proposed segments: 1) new-signups (last 14d), 2) trial-engaged (api calls >100 in last 7d). Optional micro: "opened-invite-not-registered". Different CTAs & cadence.

anya: Add 'low-engagement' (signed up >30d ago, <1 event last 14d) for a light re-engage path. For watchlist (opened invite) do a 1-email retarget at Day 2 with calendar link.

lia: I will produce a compressed hero + plain-text fallback. Suggest PNG @2x for hero, GIF only for trial-engaged.

josh: Draft subject / preview ideas:
```
A) "Benchmark: 3x inference cost savings — see the data" | preview: "Webinar + short demo, Wed 10am PT"
B) "Live benchmark: latency & cost breakdown" | preview: "Reserve your spot ")
```
UTM: `?utm_source=newsletter&utm_medium=email&utm_campaign=bench_launch_3085`

maria: Let's A/B test A vs B for new-signups, and for trial-engaged test 'Case study' vs 'Benchmark'. Also test 1-CTA (register) vs 2-CTA (register + read blog). Keep APAC send window 09:00-11:00 local.

ops-bot: seg-gen: created segments: seg_3085_newsign, seg_3085_trial, seg_3085_loweng, seg_3085_watchlist. status=ready

anya: I'll wire the watchlist rule in GA and push the segment IDs to the campaign. Will also add exclusion rules (no invite if registered).

lia: Asset ETA: hero (600x200), mobile banner (320x60), GIF (300x100) + alt-text + plain fallback. Uploading to #marketing-assets by 5:30pm.

josh: Copy constraints: welcome email 80-110 words, bullets (3 max), one primary CTA (register). Alternative 2-CTA layout for trial-engaged. I'll post exact copy variants by 3pm.

maria: Ops: send window math for timezones? We'll batch send by cohort and timezone windows. Also add a hold for APAC compliance check if account country=JP.

ops-bot: campaign-scheduler: draft created id=cmp_2026_3085; status=draft; owner=maria

sophie: Metrics to track: open rate, CTR->register, register->attend, cpl by cohort. Also flag demo requests. Assign Sam for dashboard wiring?

maria: Sam is on it. I'll lead the QA and final send ops. Reconvene tomorrow 11:00 for final checks. :white_check_mark:

josh: One more: include an unsubscribe-safe short line and plain-text calendar invite link in the Day0 invite for watchlist.

anya: For the retarget watchlist, use subject: "Still thinking about the benchmark? Quick replay + live Q&A" and include calendar link.

maria: Perfect. I'll paste final cadence + segment IDs here after QA. Thanks all.
